description: This file defines a Spring Data JPA repository interface for accessing LoanRepaymentScheduleInstallment entities. It includes custom JPQL queries to retrieve loan schedule delinquency data based on loan status, due date, obligations met status, and loan IDs, specifically for the Apache Fineract loan management system.

classes.name: LoanRepaymentScheduleInstallmentRepository
classes.description: A Spring Data JPA repository interface for LoanRepaymentScheduleInstallment entities, providing methods to fetch loan schedule delinquency data based on various filtering criteria.

methods.name: fetchLoanScheduleDataByDueDateAndObligationsMet
methods.description: Retrieves delinquency data for loans with specific loan status, due date on or before a given date, obligations met status, and non-null delinquency bucket, grouped by loan.

methods.name: fetchLoanScheduleDataByDueDateAndObligationsMet
methods.description: Retrieves delinquency data for loans with specific loan status, due date on or before a given date, obligations met status, non-null delinquency bucket, and not in the specified list of loan IDs, grouped by loan.
